"'''Rocket'''" was the nickname of a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] within the [[77th Air Wing]]'s [[Sword Squadron (Imperial)|Sword Squadron]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Rocket fought at the [[Battle of Kelrodo-Ai]] during the [[Western Reaches Operation]] of [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]].
